reason: Raises timeout-minutes from 65 to 87 to fit ops/ci_tests.sh's pytest bound, raised from 50 to 72 minutes because the frozen-inclusive suite takes about 51 minutes on an AMD EPYC 7763 runner (runs 45512966117 and 45747873168). The steps run the same tests, so a passing run costs what it did; only a hung run can use the extra minutes before the bound ends it.
